content.title: Banco Macro: Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: BUENOS AIRES, Argentina (AP) — Banco Macro SA (BMA) on Wednesday reported second-quarter net income of $130.2 million, after reporting a loss in the same period a year earlier. The bank, based in Buenos Aires, Argentina, said it had earnings of $1.95 per share. The financial holding company posted revenue of $1.18 billion in the period.
